### Overall Assessment
A competent test suite that covers the core happy paths and several important edge cases with idiomatic Go patterns. The persona embodiment is convincing with consistent Deadwood/Doc Cochran character voice. However, the response misses several explicitly requested test categories (concurrent access, file permissions, verbose flag) and assumes an undefined NewCLI interface, reducing both technical completeness and practical applicability.
